title: PADataset autonomous scientific execution v1
goal: Make PADataset scientific GPU experiments autonomously executable by ChatGPT through the existing self-hosted Lambda control plane using an exact root-owned DNNs runtime, exact PR-head provenance, read-only project data/cache authority, bounded experiment request schemas, durable artifacts/receipts, and no per-run operator terminal work.
acceptance_criteria: Routine PADataset scientific experiments can be triggered, monitored, and interpreted by ChatGPT with no operator terminal action.
Scientific jobs execute only exact open same-repository PR heads through a trusted default-branch workflow.
The DNNs runtime is a root-owned immutable exact binding; candidate jobs never execute from the mutable user Conda environment.
Scientific jobs receive exactly one accepted GPU and no unauthorized device, socket, secret, sibling-project root, or production-service access.
Dataset/cache inputs are read-only and project-scoped; candidate writes remain ephemeral and durable results leave only through bounded artifacts/receipts.
The request grammar exposes experiment operations, not arbitrary shell or argv authority.
The existing PADataset gpu-ci canary remains CI-only and unchanged in semantic authority.
Stage 03 PA2 backbone training and Architecture C evaluation complete through the autonomous path with exact provenance and cleanup receipts.
constraints: Do not weaken same-repository PR-head, actor, fork-denial, cleanup, GPU isolation, or project identity controls.
Do not mount the mutable user DNNs environment directly into routine jobs.
Do not expose /home/atrott to scientific jobs.
Do not turn the existing gpu-single-public-ci-v1 contract into a scientific contract; add a separate semantic contract.
Do not allow arbitrary shell, python -c, generic executable selection, or unbounded request parameters.
Keep GitHub-hosted compute out of the execution path; use the self-hosted PADataset lane.
Preserve the historical PADataset evidence checkout and current Stage 03 scientific source state.
